title: trailboss --json queue
description: Messages `send --queue --yes` keeps for agents mid-turn, oldest first, then the last 20 that finished. state: waiting (its turn hasn't ended), due (it has; typed once the agent is at rest), typing, or, finished, what came of it as `send` says it (sent, held, no reaction, or unknown when the delivery stopped before saying). detail says why it waits or what the look found. A message is typed only into the session it was queued for, one per rest: the next for the same agent waits for the turn the first one started to end. Frontends should show a state they don't know as is.

id.description: q1, q2, …: what `trailboss queue rm` takes.

session.description: The session it's typed into; any other one in that terminal never gets it.

state.description: waiting, due, typing, sent, held, no reaction or unknown; more may be added.

message.description: What you typed, while it's queued; null once finished (it isn't kept).

queued_ms.description: When it was queued, in Unix milliseconds.

at_ms.description: When it finished, in Unix milliseconds; null while queued.
